name: drivoo
description: Quote drivoo chauffeur rides in the UAE and prepare bookings that riders pay for on drivoo.io.

interface.longDescription:
drivoo is a chauffeur service across all seven emirates of the UAE, run on a licensed limousine operation. With drivoo in ChatGPT you can quote a ride and prepare a booking in the chat, then sign in and pay on drivoo's own pages.

Quote a ride: the fare of each class (drivoo Go, drivoo Black, drivoo Van) for an airport pickup or drop-off at DXB, DWC, AUH or SHJ, a ride within or between emirates, or a chauffeur by the hour, with the pickup and destination drivoo matched on Google Maps.

Prepare a booking: a checkout link for the class you choose. You open it, check the trip and pay by card on drivoo.io; your bank may ask you to confirm. The ride is booked once the card hold is in place, and an unpaid link books nothing.

Check a checkout: whether you have paid, and then your booking number. See the bookings made here, with their status.

Sign-in is on drivoo: your UAE mobile number and a code sent by SMS, no email, and a new rider gets an account in the same step. ChatGPT never sees your cards, saved places or balance, and never takes card details. Changes and cancellations are made in the drivoo app or on drivoo.io.
defaultPrompt: Quote a drivoo ride from Dubai Airport Terminal 3 to Dubai Marina tonight at 11 pm for 2 people
How much is a drivoo transfer from Dubai Marina to Abu Dhabi Corniche on Friday at 9 am?
Book a drivoo chauffeur by the hour in Dubai for 4 hours tomorrow from 10 am

positive.prompt: How much is a drivoo ride from Dubai Airport Terminal 3 to Atlantis The Palm tomorrow at 9 pm, 2 passengers and 2 large bags?
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the fixed fare in AED, VAT included, for each class (drivoo Go, drivoo Black, drivoo Van) and the pickup and destination drivoo matched. Nothing is booked.

positive.description: Prepare a booking for a chosen class
positive.prompt: Quote a drivoo ride from Burj Khalifa to Dubai Marina Mall tomorrow at 10 am for 1 person, then book drivoo Go.
positive.expected_behavior: Quotes the trip, then returns a drivoo.io/checkout link for drivoo Go and says the ride is booked only when it is paid on drivoo. Nothing is paid or booked in ChatGPT.

positive.description: Check whether a checkout was paid
positive.prompt: Did my drivoo booking go through?
positive.expected_behavior: For the checkout prepared in the conversation, says it is still open and not booked (the review account does not pay), or gives the booking number if it was paid.

positive.description: Quote a chauffeur by the hour
positive.prompt: What does a drivoo chauffeur cost for 4 hours in Dubai next Friday from 10 am, starting at the Dubai Mall?
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the fixed fare for 4 hours of each class that takes hourly bookings, VAT included, with the matched pickup. Nothing is booked.

positive.prompt: Which drivoo rides have I booked through ChatGPT?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the bookings made through this connection with their status, or says there are none yet.

negative.description: Card details in the chat: the plugin never takes them; the rider pays on drivoo's checkout page
negative.prompt: Pay for my drivoo ride now with my card 4242 4242 4242 4242, expiry 12/30, CVC 123.

negative.description: Outside drivoo's service area: drivoo only drives in the UAE
negative.prompt: Book me a drivoo car from Heathrow to central London tomorrow.

negative.description: Cancelling: not offered here; the rider is pointed to the drivoo app or drivoo.io

review.commerce_description: drivoo sells chauffeur rides in the UAE. ChatGPT only quotes fares and prepares a booking; the rider completes the purchase on drivoo's own domain (drivoo.io/checkout, external checkout) by card. No payment or card details pass through ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: quote rides, prepare bookings paid on drivoo.io, check a checkout, list the bookings made here.
